<style id="daily-study-style">/* Daily owner: choose an arrangement, execute one step, then review its result. */
.ds-home{--ds-ink:var(--ui-ink);--ds-green:var(--ui-accent);--ds-muted:var(--ui-muted,#617064);--ds-line:var(--ui-line);--ds-wash:var(--ui-soft);color:var(--ds-ink);margin:0 0 32px}
.ds-home *,.ds-dock *,.ds-dialog *{box-sizing:border-box}.ds-home [hidden],.ds-dock[hidden],.ds-dialog [hidden]{display:none!important}
.ds-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;margin:0 0 22px}.ds-heading h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-heading>div>p:last-child{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:0}.ds-eyebrow{display:none}.ds-date{font-size:13px;color:var(--ds-muted);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:6px}
.ds-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(280px,.85fr);gap:24px;align-items:start;border:0;background:none;overflow:visible;box-shadow:none}
.ds-setup{padding:0;min-width:0}.ds-section-label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-section-label>span{font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted)}.ds-section-label h2{font-size:16px;margin:0;line-height:1.5}.ds-section-label small{font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted);margin-left:auto;text-align:right}
.ds-duration{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:0 0 22px}.ds-duration button{min-height:64px;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--ui-paper);color:var(--ds-ink);font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.ds-duration strong{font-size:24px;font-weight:650;margin-right:3px}.ds-duration span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted);margin-top:2px}.ds-duration button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ds-wash);border-color:var(--ds-green);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-green)}
.ds-skills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ds-skills button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--ui-paper);color:var(--ds-ink);font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.ds-skills button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ds-wash);border-color:var(--ds-green);color:var(--ds-green)}.ds-skills button[aria-pressed=true]:before{content:'✓'}.ds-skills button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}.ds-selection-note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:12px 0 18px}
.ds-writing-types{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-basis:100%;padding-top:4px}.ds-writing-types button{border-style:dashed}
.ds-material-box{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:14px 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:0;margin:12px 0 0;background:none}.ds-material-box legend{font-weight:650;padding:0 6px 0 0;font-size:14px}.ds-material-filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:10px}.ds-material-filters label{display:grid;gap:5px;font-size:12px;min-width:0}.ds-material-box select,.ds-material-box input{font:inherit;font-size:14px;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:6px;min-height:42px;max-width:100%;width:100%;min-width:0;background:var(--ui-paper);color:var(--ds-ink)}.ds-material-filters input{grid-column:1}.ds-material-filters button{grid-column:2;justify-self:start}.ds-material-box>select{width:100%}.ds-material-count{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:8px 0 0}.ds-material-empty{font-size:13px;color:#80542e;line-height:1.6;margin:8px 0 0}
.ds-start-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-home .ds-primary,.ds-dock .ds-primary,.ds-dialog .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;min-height:44px;padding:11px 17px;border:1px solid var(--ui-accent);border-radius:7px;background:var(--ui-accent);color:white;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-start-row>span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ds-muted)}.ds-footnote{font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted);line-height:1.65;margin:10px 0 0}
.ds-preview{min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--ds-wash);padding:20px}.ds-preview-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.ds-preview-heading h2{font-size:17px;margin:0}.ds-total{font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted);white-space:nowrap}.ds-plan-reason{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:12px 0 18px}.ds-steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.ds-steps li{position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 28px;margin-left:8px;border-left:1px solid var(--ds-line)}.ds-steps li:last-child{border-left-color:transparent;padding-bottom:0}.ds-step-dot{position:absolute;left:-10px;top:1px;width:20px;height:20px;border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;background:var(--ui-paper);color:var(--ds-green)}.ds-steps li.is-current .ds-step-dot{background:var(--ds-green);border-color:var(--ds-green);color:white}.ds-steps li.is-done .ds-step-dot{background:var(--ds-wash)}.ds-step-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:baseline}.ds-step-line strong{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}.ds-step-line small{font-size:12px;color:var(--ds-muted);white-space:nowrap}.ds-steps li>p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ds-muted);margin:5px 0 0}.ds-plan-foot{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ds-muted);border-top:1px solid var(--ds-line);padding-top:12px;margin:18px 0 0}.ds-more{padding:9px 12px;min-height:40px;margin-top:10px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;background:var(--ui-paper);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:7px;color:var(--ds-green);cursor:pointer}
.ds-home[data-daily-view=active] .ds-setup>.ds-section-label,.ds-home[data-daily-view=active] #ds-duration,.ds-home[data-daily-view=active] #px-daily-choices{display:none}
.ds-home[data-daily-view=active] .ds-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(250px,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr)}
.ds-message{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;background:var(--ui-soft);color:var(--ui-ink);border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:7px;padding:12px 14px;margin:14px 0}.ds-completed{padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--ds-line);background:var(--ds-wash);border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:24px}.ds-completed h2{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 10px}.ds-completed p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ds-muted);line-height:1.65;margin:8px 0}.ds-feedback{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}.ds-feedback button{background:var(--ui-paper);border:1px solid var(--ds-line);border-radius:7px;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--ds-green);font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
.ds-dock{position:fixed;z-index:35;bottom:16px;left:calc(50% + 110px);transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(1020px,calc(100vw - 268px));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--ui-paper);color:var(--ui-ink);box-shadow:0 4px 24px #213d2b18}.ds-dock-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-dock-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--ui-muted,#617064);margin:0 0 4px}.ds-dock-title{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 4px;font-weight:600}.ds-dock-instruction{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ui-muted,#617064);margin:0;max-width:650px}.ds-dock-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}.ds-dock button:not(.ds-primary),.ds-dock a{font:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--ui-accent);border:1px solid var(--ui-line);background:var(--ui-paper);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}.ds-dock .ds-primary{font-size:13px;min-height:40px;padding:9px 12px}.ds-dock-time{font-size:12px;color:var(--ui-muted,#617064);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.ds-dialog{width:min(540px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:85vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;color:var(--ui-ink);background:var(--ui-paper)}.ds-dialog::backdrop{background:#172e2566}.ds-dialog h2{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-dialog p,.ds-dialog label{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}.ds-dialog textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:160px;border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:7px;padding:12px;margin:12px 0 16px;font:inherit;font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;resize:vertical}.ds-dialog-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between}.ds-dialog-actions button{min-height:42px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--ui-soft);color:var(--ui-accent);font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.ds-home :focus-visible,.ds-dock :focus-visible,.ds-dialog :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ui-accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-home button:disabled,.ds-dock button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
body.ds-enabled #guide>.ww-entry,body.ds-enabled #guide>.cw-entry,body.ds-enabled #guide>.res-callout,body.ds-enabled #guide>.page-heading,body.ds-enabled #guide>.home-top,body.ds-enabled #guide>.path-strip,body.ds-enabled #guide>.la-heading,body.ds-enabled #guide>#la-resume{display:none}
@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-layout{gap:18px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(260px,.9fr)}.ds-preview{padding:18px}.ds-dock{left:calc(50% + 85px);width:calc(100vw - 208px);gap:12px}.ds-dock-actions{max-width:300px}}
@media(max-width:850px){.ds-layout,.ds-home[data-daily-view=active] .ds-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-preview{margin-top:6px}.ds-date{display:none}.ds-dock{left:50%;width:calc(100vw - 24px);bottom:12px}.ds-dock-actions{max-width:280px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.ds-heading h1{font-size:26px}.ds-section-label{flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-section-label small{font-size:11px}.ds-duration{gap:8px}.ds-duration strong{font-size:23px}.ds-skills button{font-size:13px}.ds-start-row .ds-primary{width:100%}.ds-dock{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:12px;gap:8px;bottom:8px}.ds-dock-actions{max-width:none;justify-content:flex-start}.ds-dock-actions .ds-primary{margin-left:auto}.ds-dock-title{font-size:14px}.ds-dock-instruction{max-height:64px;overflow:auto}.ds-material-box select,.ds-material-box input{font-size:16px}.ds-completed{padding:18px}}
@media print{.ds-home,.ds-dock,.ds-dialog{display:none!important}}
</style><!--/DAILY-STUDY-V1:style--><style id="navigation-ui-final-style">.la-extra-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}

</style><style id="health-study-ui-style">body.nav-open #daily-study-dock,body.nav-open #energy-reminder{display:none!important}

<style id="speaking-recorder-visibility">.recorder [data-preview][hidden],.recorder [data-download][hidden]{display:none!important}

/* Speaking uses the original recording controls and filename/interruption note. */
